Name: Animation-Cancel Keybinding
Author: Swaglix
Description:
Adds a keybind to cancel the animation of a tool or whatever to another key, if f.e. you use the space key and don't want to disable it for the prairie king minigame.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]Use[/size]
[list=1]
[*]set the key to the desired one (or leave it at space, which is the default one) with one of the following options:
[list]
[*] Using the ui from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Config Menu[/url] Mod.
[*] After installing the mod and starting the game, in the mod folder should a config.json file exist, there you can manually change it.
[/list]
[*] Press the key while using a tool, f.e. a sword or pickaxe and have fun playing.
[/list]
[size=5]See also[/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]
[*][url=https://github.com/GreenUserBlue/AnimationCancelKey]Source code[/url]
[/list]

[size=4]Special Thanks[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][url=https://github.com/focustense]focustense [/url] for additional settings[/size]
[/list]
